newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: Britain's Prince Philip meets UAE president.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Prince Philip meets UAE president.

text.p: Britain's Prince Philip on Thursday met United Arab Emirates President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan and visited a nature reserve in the Gulf Arab state.
The official Emirates news agency WAM reported the meeting with Sheikh Zaid but did not give details. It said Prince Philip earlier in the day visited a nature reserve on the island of Sir Bani Yas.
He arrived in Abu Dhabi on a two-day working visit in his capacity as president emeritus of the Geneva-based World Wide Fund for Nature.
The visit is part of an international tour that includes trips to Hungary, Turkey, Oman, Mongolia, Japan, Russia, the United States and Canada.
